summary:
Implemented the fix in [src/codegen.rs](/app/src/codegen.rs): `Ref`-typed getters now generate borrowed return types like `-> &Company` instead of owned `-> Company`, matching the `&self.field` body and supporting chained accessors.

Verification: `./test.sh` passes. It still prints two `grep: invalid option -- '>'` warnings from the harness pattern handling, but exits successfully with `PASS: All code generation tests passed`.
